sources.title: Truss bridge
sources.verification: Read with a web-fetch tool on 2026-10-27 (sections 'Pratt truss', 'Warren truss').

claims.text: A Pratt truss has vertical members and diagonals that slope down towards the centre.

evidence.excerpt: A Pratt truss includes vertical members and diagonals that slope down towards the center, the opposite of the Howe truss.

claims.text: A Warren truss forms alternately inverted triangles along its length, with no vertical members.

evidence.excerpt: forming alternately inverted equilateral triangle-shaped spaces along its length ... with no vertical elements

claims.scope: web arrangement only; the model uses isosceles (not equilateral) triangles so it shares the Pratt frame
